summary: The POST endpoint tools (geocode, route, matrix, isochrone, toll, validate and similar) must declare readOnlyHint, because this API only reads or computes and creates, updates or deletes nothing remote.
reason: The generator marks read-only from the HTTP method, so every POST endpoint loses readOnlyHint. Under DELHIVERY_MAPS_MCP_READ_ONLY=1 the filter then removes most of the API, leaving agents with only the local commands.
